posts.zh:
dsh-lan-pass 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。Web UI 局域网密码门禁：同网手机/平板输共享密钥登录，会话与电脑实时同步，内置 randomUUID polyfill。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-24ae3d540eadf3c3416c.html
posts.en:
dsh-lan-pass is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. A LAN password gate for the Web UI: phones and tablets on the same network log in with a shared key and see the same sessions in real time, with a built-in randomUUID polyfill for plain-HTTP origins.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-24ae3d540eadf3c3416c.html
